transformation_rules: Only listed prefix replacements for copied UTF-8 files; PNGs are byte-identical. People setup summary uses the separately documented identifier field allowlist. REPRODUCTION.md is authored documentation. Embedded hashes refer to original source files unless explicitly described as archive hashes. The coordinator_closeout field records later cleanup-receipt and documentation augmentation; those entries preserve both original and pre-closeout hashes.
integrity: Entries use paths relative to this runtime directory. Original hashes refer to source bytes before replacement. The manifest excludes itself to avoid a self hash.

encodings: percent/plus URL encoding with upper/lower percent digits
hex-literal case variants, decoded hex key bytes and their Base64/percent encodings
credential_scan.method: Byte search over every archived file before writing; no credential values emitted.
credential_scan.limitations: A positive-string scan is not a proof against unknown secrets or an OCR scan of screenshot pixels.

cleanup_state_at_packaging: Owned processes/services/volume/network removed and four owned ports closed. Shared services unchanged. Private credential/scratch removal remains pending; coordinator owns later receipt and manifest-entry refresh.

entries.transformation: authored in repository; no copy transformation; coordinator appended actual private-file cleanup after source removal
none; coordinator appended actual private-file cleanup after source removal
explicit field allowlist for synthetic identifiers; full private context excluded

coordinator_closeout.reason: Append actual private-file removal after successful archive integrity/credential checks; original copied hashes remain recorded
